engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Sound System Data Set incorrect or doesn't match Vehicle Equipment
stepByStepSolution: Gerçekleştirin: Software Version Management (SVM) Kontrol edin: on installed Components.
technicalNotes: If the Kontrol Modülü has been retrofitted and the cars original Kontrol Modülü didn't come with such an option, the Software Version Management (SVM) Kontrol edin: will not solve the problem. So far there is no other way known to fix this problem.
